newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rexrodt reaffirms forecast 2.5 pct growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt reaffirms forecast 2.5 pct growth in 1997.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Wednesday that final data showing flat fourth quarter output had been taken into account in the government's economic forecast of 2.5 percent GDP growth this year.
"This exactly meets the assumptions on which our annual economic report was based," Rexrodt said in a statement.
Earlier, the Bundesbank published figures which showed that fourth quarter economic output rose by 0.1 percent against the third quarter and by 2.2 percent over a year earlier.

The 2.5 percent growth forecast was made in January, but has been battered since by data showing unemployment has hit the highest since the 1930s. The growth forecast underpins Bonn's efforts to boost state revenues to make the grade for European monetary union (EMU) this year.
